MECP Cartesian gradient and reaction-coordinate definitions
Workflow mode = MECP_ONLY
Run mode = CLUSTER

Low-spin multiplicity  = 1 (singlet)
High-spin multiplicity = 3 (triplet)

Definitions:
surface_gradient_difference_cart = g_LS - g_HS
reverse_surface_gradient_difference_cart = g_HS - g_LS
GRADIENT_GAP_NORM_EH_PER_BOHR = ||g_LS - g_HS||
CARTESIAN_GEOMETRIC_MEAN_GRADIENT_EH_PER_BOHR = sqrt(||g_LS|| * ||g_HS||)
The final reaction-coordinate-projected gradient measure is calculated later and is not defined in Step 4.

||g_LS|| = 1.132894839875e-02 Eh/Bohr
||g_HS|| = 4.880360827634e-02 Eh/Bohr
g_LS_dot_g_HS = -5.330094374428e-04
intersection_type = peaked
GRADIENT_GAP_NORM_EH_PER_BOHR = 5.980097095782e-02 Eh/Bohr
cartesian_geometric_mean_gradient_Eh_per_Bohr = 2.351368877560e-02 Eh/Bohr
CARTESIAN_GEOMETRIC_MEAN_GRADIENT_EH_PER_BOHR = 2.351368877560e-02 Eh/Bohr
effective_hessian_mix_coefficient = 1.849344619434e-01
